#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# Resolve paths relative to this script so cron may run it from any directory.
SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

DEST='backup-srv:/srv/nightly'
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
printf 'wrote %s and copied it to %s\n' "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"

arguments.command: sh -n backup.sh && git diff --check && git diff -- backup.sh
